gar-saxon--viceroy-of-mandalore.rules:
If Gar Saxon is defeated simultaneously with other friendly units, all “When Defeated” abilities still trigger.
You may only use Gar Saxon’s unit side ability to return upgrades that were attached to the unit when it was defeated.
